Precautions Imipenem-cilastatin should not be given to patients known to be hypersensitive to it, and should be given with caution to patients known to be hypersensitive to penicillins, cephalosporins, or other beta lactams be- cause of the possibility of cross-sensitivity. It should be given with caution to patients with renal impairment, and the dose reduced appropriately. Par- ticular care is necessary in patients with CNS disorders such as epilepsy.
